coaching.headline: Four lane reads went against us and we won anyway — 63k objective damage to their 19k, and every major from 16 minutes on.
coaching.team: The paper said carry, mid, offlane and jungle were all behind, and the kill line ended 19-19 — but the objective ledger was a rout: Fangtooth at 10, 16 and 21, Genesis 24, Orb 26, Primal 27. Even our lost fights were trades (15.3 and 16.1 both gave bodies while Fangtooth banked cross-map). The wobble to own: 21.4 went 0-2 with a 5v4 man advantage, and 1 of 5 itemized magic resist against Iggy & Scorch's 33k magical. From 25 minutes we won three teamfights (3-1, 3-1, 5-1) and closed at their inhibitor.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Surviving the 16-19 minute push by trading it for Fangtooth, then the 25 and 27.1 fight wins that banked Orb and Primal — the 31.1-minute 5-1 finished it.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Legion lost the offlane read to Narbash all game and got caught at 10 by Khaimera — but 5/5/5 with 12.6k objective damage and a body in the 27.1 Primal fight is the right way to lose a lane. The build note: Vanquisher was the missing core piece (the Malady / Vanquisher / Deathstalker core runs 56.9% over 1357 games).
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Kallari's 30.8k objective damage — top of the lobby — is the single biggest reason four losing lane reads became a win, and 8 wards beat the jungle norm for once. The only flag: no magic resist against a 3-magical comp with Iggy & Scorch at 33k; one item covers the dive exits.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Narbash. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought none.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.
